(Settings... in current versions of MacOS).,Sound is optional and can be turned on or off for this module on the Preferences...Sounds tab.,Draw & end turn with one press of the button from the main toolbar.,To draw an extra card (special rules)\, use the button in your player hand. ,The Help toolbar menu lists several useful resources for playing the game and using this module.,Zoom the map using hotkeys ⌃[ and ⌃]. To quickly adjust a map view in its window\, try the "fit" options under the magnifying glass toolbar button.,Find Victory Banner & other special blocks on the terrain palette [F4].,Short of an opponent? Try a solo mode! See Help...Module User's Guide (Solitaire section).,Solitaire users: choose a solo mode from Preferences...Game Options or disable auto-start to use normal mode\, or start your game from the <observer> role.,Log your game results on the commandsandcolors.net scenario home page (see Help menu).
